DescriptionAdjustBandwidthLimit: Enter a non-negative integer as the new bandwidth limit in Megabits per second (Mbps). To set no bandwidth limit on the transfer, please enter 0. The new bandwidth limit may take up to one minute before taking effect.
ErrorConsecutiveSlashDirectory: Directory path must not contain consecutive slashes.
ErrorDownloadPlatformProtocolMismatch: Downloading from NFS file shares is currently not supported on non-Linux platforms.
ErrorMessageInvalidBandwidthLimit: The bandwidth limit value must be a non-negative integer.
ErrorMultiSnapshotDownloadNotSupported: Multi-snapshot download is currently not supported.
ErrorNameEndWithDot: Directory or file names must not end with a period.
ErrorNameRestrictedCharacters: Directory or file names must not contain the following characters: " : | < > * ?
ErrorNameTooLong: Directory or file names must be no more than 255 characters in length.
ErrorNotDirectoryPath: Directory path must end with a slash.
ErrorUnsupportedFromTo: Copying from '%1$s' to '%2$s' is currently unsupported.
ErrorUploadPlatformProtocolMismatch: Uploading to NFS file shares is currently not supported on non-Linux platforms.
MessageCredentialStoreErrorOccurred: There was a problem interacting with the system credential store during an AzCopy transfer. This may cause issues with long-running transfers.
OptionStoredAccessPolicyCheckLength: Check length after transfer (requires read permission).
OptionStoredAccessPolicyPromptForConflic: Prompt for conflicts (requires read permission). If disabled, conflicts will be overwritten.
WarningCopyNoWritePermission: Your credential does not authorize AzCopy to write blocks to the destination blob. AzCopy will therefore attempt to write all the data in one block, which may cause the transfer to fail if the data is too large.
WarningNoReadPermission: Your credential does not authorize AzCopy to read the contents of the destination. AzCopy will therefore attempt to overwrite if there are conflicts and will not be able to check content length at the end of each transfer.
WarningNoTagsPermission: Your credential does not authorize AzCopy to read or write blob tags. AzCopy will therefore not attempt to preserve blob tags from the source.
WarningNoWritePermission: Your credential does not authorize AzCopy to delete read-only files.
WarningUnknownPermissions: Storage Explorer cannot determine what permissions have been granted by your credentials. These permissions affect certain AzCopy features. For each feature, indicate if the feature should be enabled.
